title: Rudrashtakam
author: Goswami Tulsidas
intro: Eight verses to Shiva as Rudra, from the Uttarakanda of Tulsidas's Ramcharitmanas (16th century), followed by a closing verse. Like the Nirvana Shatkam, it uses the Bhujangaprayata meter (◡ — — four times per line), which gives it its flowing, chant-like rhythm.
note: The first eight verses are in Bhujangaprayata; the closing verse is in Anushtubh. Tulsidas's Sanskrit is lightly Hindi-flavoured, and one line (verse 7) bends the meter slightly.
